reviews.text:
I have this cushion from before reformulation and wanted to try updated version. First off, the Kuromi packing is ADORABLE! The formula is very dewy with a sheer/light coverage. It can't be built up too much but it keeps the skin looking so glowy and healthy all day.
*Swatch photo taken with flash.
reviews.zh: 我之前用過改配方前嘅版本，想試吓新版。首先，Kuromi 嘅包裝超級得意！質地好水光，遮瑕偏通透／輕盈。唔可以疊加太多層，但成日都keep到皮膚睇落好水潤健康。\n*試色相用閃光燈影嘅。

reviews.text: It’s very very cute but the coverage is very low . I have freckles and dark spots and this one is not covering them at all . If you’re looking for a very low coverage that looks very natural it’s good . love the stickers
reviews.zh: 超級超級得意，但遮瑕力好低。我有雀斑同色斑，呢款完全遮唔到。如果你想要低遮瑕、睇落好自然嘅妝效，咁就啱。好鍾意啲貼紙。

reviews.text: Amuse Dew Jelly is the ONLY cushion i will use! It is seriously the best - moisturizing YET not sticky or oily and feels like skincare. It gives the most natural dewy finish, and I constantly receive compliments about how good my skin looks…it’s the dew jelly cushion!!
reviews.zh: Amuse Dew Jelly 係我唯一會用嘅氣墊！真係最好用——保濕但又唔會黏笠或油笠，感覺好似護膚品咁。妝效係最自然嘅水光，成日都有人讚我皮膚好……就係 dew jelly 氣墊！！

reviews.text: Medium Buildable coverage. Unfortunately the shade range is unbearable, the darkest shade is too light for me and I am a fair complexion. The dew finish is nice though because it dries down to a soft dewy finish so it doesnt look oily.
reviews.zh: 中等遮瑕，可以疊加。可惜色號範圍真係接受唔到，最深嘅色號對我嚟講都仲係太淺（我膚色算白）。水光妝效幾好，因為會乾到變成柔和嘅水光效果，所以唔會望落油笠笠。

reviews.text: This cushion is very dewy and it has light to medium coverage, the cushion puff provided isn’t the most comfortable to use but this could be great for people with dry skin who don’t need much coverage
reviews.zh: 呢款氣墊好水光，遮瑕屬於輕至中等，附送嘅粉撲用得唔算舒服，但對乾性肌又唔需要太高遮瑕嘅人嚟講可能好啱。

reviews.text: Very runny and light. A very light foundation more like a BB or CC cream. Its just to even out skin tone rather than covering acne or heavy pigmentation. Doesnt layer either. It is very dewy though. As i have heavy acne scars i wiped it off so not sure on the longevity of the product.
reviews.zh: 好水好薄。屬於好薄身嘅粉底，更似 BB 或 CC 霜。純粹係均勻膚色，唔係用嚟遮暗瘡或嚴重色斑。亦都唔可以層疊。不過真係好水光。因為我有嚴重暗瘡印，抹咗佢，所以唔知持久度點。

reviews.text: The packaging is adorable and the bonus items of stickers and silicone brush make this a fun bundle. With that out of the way this is a dewy formula that can give off a nice shine, but can also give an oily look for certain skin types. I also got this in 1.5 with is the darkest shade. It matches great with my skin tone, but if you are any darker this most likely won't work for you. It's also a thinner formula that can give off a natural glow, but won't be high or even medium coverage for those that need it. Overall I think it's a fine cushion.
reviews.zh: 包裝好得意，送嘅貼紙同矽膠粉掃等額外送嘅嘢成個package幾有趣。講完呢啲，呢款係水光質地，可以做到好靚嘅光澤感，但對某啲膚質嚟講亦都可以望落油笠笠。我買咗 1.5，係最深嘅色號。同我膚色夾得好好，但如果你再深色啲，呢款大多數啱你唔到。質地偏薄，可以做到自然光澤感，但需要高遮瑕甚至中等遮瑕嘅人就唔得。整體嚟講我覺得係唔錯嘅氣墊。

reviews.text:
Absolutely in love with this cushion!

My favorite cushions have always been from AMUSE, and this KUROMI Edition Dew Jelly Master is no exception! 

The packaging is so cute and stylish, every detail is done perfectly. 💜

The formula feels light but gives amazing coverage, and the dewy finish makes my skin look fresh and glowy all day. 
 It blends beautifully and never feels heavy or cakey.

AMUSE really knows how to create cushions that combine quality, design, and skincare benefits. This one definitely lives up to the hype, I’m obsessed!
reviews.zh:
完全愛上咗呢款氣墊！

我最鍾意嘅氣墊一直以嚟都係 AMUSE，呢款 KUROMI Edition Dew Jelly Master 當然都唔例外！

包裝超得意又型，每個細節都做得好完美。💜

質地感覺好輕但遮瑕超好，水光妝效令皮膚成日都keep到清新水潤。
推開得好靚，唔會厚重亦都唔會浮粉。

AMUSE 真係識得做將品質、設計同護膚功效集於一身嘅氣墊。呢款完全冇令期望落空，我已經迷上咗！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
